Water-area classification uses OpenFreeMap vector data based on OpenMapTiles
and OpenStreetMap. The data is requested on demand; it is not used to render
or replace the Kakao map.

OpenFreeMap: https://openfreemap.org/
OpenMapTiles: https://www.openmaptiles.org/
OpenStreetMap data: Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

OpenStreetMap data is made available under the Open Data Commons Open Database
License (ODbL) 1.0:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/

Vector-tile water-layer schema:
https://openmaptiles.org/schema/#water

This application only classifies a selected location against the water
polygons. Freshwater, inland, uncertain, and unavailable locations do not
enable marine-only information automatically.
